mistake: Use source URL/filename/acta number as primary identity
failure_mode: Identity changes/redirects/version replacements break references

mistake: Resolve entities by normalized name during extraction
failure_mode: Same-name people/projects are falsely merged and raw evidence is lost

mistake: Store all knowledge as generic nodes/edges/triples
failure_mode: Rich relation attributes and maintenance semantics become ambiguous/complex

mistake: Materialize co-occurrence or transitive closure edges
failure_mode: Graph explodes and derived meaning becomes stale

mistake: Let external tools/plugins write SQLite directly
failure_mode: Application invariants, permissions and referential integrity are bypassed

mistake: Put SQLite/WAL on synced or network filesystem
failure_mode: Locking/shared-memory assumptions break and corruption risk rises

mistake: Copy a live SQLite main file as backup
failure_mode: Snapshot can be inconsistent/incomplete under WAL

mistake: Make FTS/search index canonical
failure_mode: Index drift/rebuild behavior can contradict source tables

mistake: Overwrite original with OCR/redaction/edited PDF
failure_mode: Evidence custody and old locators are destroyed

mistake: Treat absence in one scrape as deletion
failure_mode: Coverage/freshness gaps create false lifecycle events

mistake: Make specialized parsers “resilient” by guessing changed structure
failure_mode: Plausible bad data silently enters the Fichero

mistake: Allow output manifests/plugins arbitrary URLs or paths
failure_mode: SSRF/local file exfiltration/DoS become extension capabilities

mistake: Use a universal truth/epistemic status column
failure_mode: Provenance, review, conflict and assessment are collapsed into one misleading value

mistake: Universal event sourcing/operation receipts for everything
failure_mode: Noise/storage/privacy/complexity overwhelm the few consequential provenance events

mistake: Adopt RDF/OWL/XML standard stack as core runtime
failure_mode: Interoperability vocabulary becomes operational complexity unrelated to canton needs

mistake: Treat SQL DELETE or FTS row removal as completed lawful purge
failure_mode: Sensitive content can remain recoverable in SQLite pages, FTS shadow/index structures, WAL files, snapshots or backups

mistake: Collapse logical custody identity into one digest-unique artifact row
failure_mode: Independent provenance/restriction/purge scopes become coupled merely because captured bytes are identical

mistake: Treat a Claim-to-Tag assignment as an unversioned pair that must be deleted to correct it
failure_mode: Retrieval history and machine/rule provenance are lost when an anchor is corrected

mistake: Record machine/rule origin without exact attributable process identity
failure_mode: Generated semantic data claims provenance that cannot be reproduced or audited

mistake: Store mutable civic-document metadata directly on the stable document identity
failure_mode: Reprocessing or correction silently rewrites title/issuer/date/language history

mistake: Treat every ClaimRelation type as having identical directionality
failure_mode: Symmetric relations disappear from reverse queries or get duplicated as fake canonical reverse edges
